Apple - Apple Scab.description: The Apple plant is showing signs of Apple Scab, a fungal infection.
things_to_inspect: Check for leaf wetness or humidity around the plant.
Inspect the spacing between plants for adequate airflow.
Look for spreading spots or fuzzy growth on adjacent leaves.
monitor_signs: Expanding spots or lesions on leaves.
Fuzzy fungal growth on leaf surfaces.
general_actions: Improve plant spacing to increase airflow.
Avoid overhead watering to keep leaves dry.
Prune and carefully dispose of infected leaves.
